top_issues.issue: Side list keeps its full 232pt width in a 760pt window, so names truncate after 9-12 characters and the conversation column shrinks to ~460pt.
top_issues.evidence: List spans x=64-296 at 760pt; 'Design rev...', 'Grace Hop...', 'Katherine Jo...', 'Dorothy Vaug...' 2pt from the phone icon; hover toolbar drops to 3 emoji.
top_issues.fix: Below 900pt window width, shrink the list to 200pt and move the timestamp under the name, or collapse to a 64pt avatar strip with a toggle. Keep at least 8pt between an ellipsis and trailing icons.

top_issues.issue: Detail pages use left-aligned fixed-width cards with different widths (Calendar 640pt, Calls 680pt) while conversations use a centred column, so pages feel unrelated and leave ~250pt dead space on the right.
top_issues.evidence: Calendar card x=388-1028, Calls card x=388-1068 at 1280pt; chat column centred at 680-1600 in the 1920 shot.
top_issues.fix: Use one shared content column (max 720pt, centred, 24pt side padding) for Calendar detail, Calls and conversations.

top_issues.issue: Dialog footers are inconsistent: primary bottom-left with helper text (New chat), primary-left then secondary (Permission), right-aligned Cancel/Save (Status message), lone left-aligned secondary (Join on phone).
top_issues.evidence: Primary button at x=400 (New chat), x=432 (Permission), x=777 right edge (Status message).
top_issues.fix: One footer pattern: buttons right-aligned, secondary then primary, 8pt gap, 20pt above; helper text goes above the buttons in 12pt muted.

top_issues.issue: In meeting mode the navigation rail and chat list vanish, so there is no way to answer another chat without leaving the meeting layout; 'Restore' is ambiguous.
top_issues.evidence: 380pt and 720pt shots show only the call bar, meeting chat header and composer; no rail.
top_issues.fix: Keep a 48pt icon rail (Chat/Teams/Calendar/Calls, unread badge) or add a chat switcher button in the call bar; rename 'Restore' to 'Show full window'.

top_issues.issue: Pasted-image thumbnails are cropped to fill, so wide or tall images are unrecognisable, and the remove buttons sit on the image.
top_issues.evidence: 3072x256 tile shows two partial birds; 256x3072 shows fragments; x buttons at (523,613),(675,613),(827,613) inside tiles.
top_issues.fix: Letterbox (contain) each image in a 144x96pt tile on #eeeef0 / #2c2d33, place the 20pt remove button at the tile's top-right corner offset -6pt, 12pt inner padding.

top_issues.issue: Shortcuts dialog is not vertically centred and nearly touches the window bottom; it will clip at smaller heights.
top_issues.evidence: Dialog top y=90, bottom y=787 (13pt from the edge) in an 800pt window.
top_issues.fix: Centre vertically with max-height = window height - 64pt and a scroll body, or switch to two columns (Navigation + App | Messages) at 720pt wide to halve the height.

top_issues.issue: Meeting detail is sparse and the grid breaks: boilerplate invite text sits in the label column without a label, and event dot meaning (filled blue vs hollow) is unexplained.
top_issues.evidence: 'Join on your computer, mobile app or room device.' starts at x=405 (label column); blue dot #1f63c6 (dark #7cb4f5, the link colour) vs orange accent #a9530f.
top_issues.fix: Add Attendees (with response status) and Location rows from Graph, drop or move the boilerplate below the card in 12pt muted, and add a tooltip or legend ('Busy' / 'Free') for the dots; consider the accent or neutral grey instead of blue.

top_issues.issue: A failed send is shown in the conversation but not in the chat list, so the person may not notice it after switching chats.
top_issues.evidence: Ada Lovelace row still reads 'Amazing. I'll write the release not...' 12:27 while the newest message (12:41) failed.
top_issues.fix: Show 'You: Here are the throttling numbers.' with a 12pt alert icon in #c42b2b (light) / #f27474 (dark) and 'Not sent' in place of the time.

top_issues.issue: Control boundaries only just clear 3:1 and one falls below it: input, button, checkbox and chip borders.
top_issues.evidence: Light #8a8d95 on #f6f6f7 = 3.07:1, on #ffffff 3.32:1, 'Explore the demo' on #f3f3f4 = 2.99:1; dark #6e7179 on #25262b = 3.09:1.
top_issues.fix: Light border #7c7f87 (about 3.7:1 on #f6f6f7); dark border #7a7d86 (about 3.6:1 on #25262b).

top_issues.issue: Join button and meeting-link input have different heights.
top_issues.fix: Use 32pt for single-line inputs and buttons app-wide (filter field too), vertically centred in the row.

top_issues.issue: Checkbox helper paragraph is not indented to the checkbox label.
top_issues.evidence: Helper text starts at x=382, label at x=408.
top_issues.fix: Indent helper text by 26pt (checkbox 16pt + 10pt gap) and use 12pt muted #62656d / #9c9ea8 with 4pt above.

top_issues.issue: Channel post cards barely separate from the page and every post repeats a bordered Reply button.
top_issues.fix: Give cards a fill (#fafafb light / #1d1e22 dark) or border #d0d1d6 / #3a3b42, and make Reply a text button (13pt, accent colour) shown on hover or for the last post.

top_issues.issue: Mention popup is anchored to the composer's left edge, covers the last message and offers no header or key hint.
top_issues.evidence: Popup x=380-694, y=613-665 over Katherine Johnson's avatar and text.
top_issues.fix: Anchor at the caret x, add a 11pt 'PEOPLE' header and a 'Tab or Enter to insert' hint, shadow 0 4 12 rgba(0,0,0,0.16).

top_issues.issue: The list column is entirely blank in the empty state.
top_issues.evidence: x=64-364 below the header is plain #f6f6f7 / #1d1e22.
top_issues.fix: Show a 13pt muted 'No chats yet' line at the list top, or hide the list column until there is a chat.

top_issues.issue: Inter's wide hyphen makes words read as split ('On - call', 'Sign - in', 'go/no - go', 'F4KQ - 9TZW').
top_issues.evidence: Visible in list title, sign-in failure title, calendar event title, device code.
top_issues.fix: For screenshots and the bundled font, enable Inter's 'case' or use U+2011 / a narrower hyphen glyph; for the device code use a monospace face or an en space with no hyphen.

top_issues.issue: Setup card is dense and the GUID placeholder looks like a filled value.
top_issues.evidence: 8pt between the paragraph and 'Open the registration guide'; 14pt between field and next label; placeholder #62656d in monospace.
top_issues.fix: 16pt between groups, 6pt label-to-field; placeholder text 'e.g. 00000000-...' in proportional italic or lighter weight.

top_issues.issue: Image preview has no actions or file name.
top_issues.evidence: Header shows only 'Image preview', Fit/100% and '3072 x 256'.
top_issues.fix: Add file name in the title and Copy / Save buttons (secondary style) right of the zoom toggle; add 'Esc to close' hint 12pt muted.
